scope: Reviewed Projects field/view/metric subset; not certified complete six-source reconciliation.

rows.conflict: View greater-than age examples say older while archive less-than examples also use last-period prose; syntax/prose disagree.
rows.requirement: Independently test exact qualifier/comparator/timezone/platform before adopting inactivity predicate.
rows.negative_test: Recent/old boundary fixtures must not be inverted by prose; unresolved comparator cannot pass.

rows.conflict: View negated no/text wildcard differs from automation subset; wildcard text cloud-only.
rows.requirement: Parameterize UI view/chart/auto-add/auto-archive and platform feature adapters; reject unsupported qualifier visibly.
rows.negative_test: GHES text wildcard and auto-add negated no cannot silently share general search parser.

rows.conflict: Unsaved view privacy does not cover actual drag/group field writes.
rows.requirement: Classify presentation configuration versus project/issue data mutation, exact target identities and write authority.
rows.negative_test: Unsaved dot must not defer or privatize item writes; hiding field cannot certify denied access.

rows.conflict: Board limit recommended for focus but explicitly permits excess from people/automation.
rows.requirement: Represent column limit as detection threshold; separate authorized enforced WIP control if desired.
rows.negative_test: Configured limit with successful excess addition cannot certify blocking enforcement.

rows.conflict: Archived/deleted items omitted from charts; lifecycle Completed and sub-issue progress not independent acceptance.
rows.requirement: Declare item identity, filtered/archive/redaction scope, units, freshness and independent acceptance evidence; maintain immutable full denominator separately.
rows.negative_test: Archiving must not improve full completion percentage by shrinking denominator; closed-not-planned cannot count accepted work.

rows.conflict: Date lacks defaults while text/number/select defaults affect new items; grouped/filtered creation also sets values.
rows.requirement: Parameterize field type and origin/default/group/filter initialization; independently verify conflicting values and existing-item nonbackfill.
rows.negative_test: New value conflict cannot silently certify desired state; removing default must not claim existing values cleared.

rows.conflict: Issue field edits sync repository state; project drafts/conversion carry different authority.
rows.requirement: Separate repository issue state from project custom fields, exact conversion destination/audience and per-operation permissions.
rows.negative_test: Project writer role alone cannot certify authorized repository write or conversion disclosure.

rows.conflict: Undo button/field or iteration deletion procedures do not establish durable complete recovery.
rows.requirement: Capture old values/identity/dependencies and authorized recovery evidence; unspecified restoration remains unknown.
rows.negative_test: Undo UI alone must not pass recovery; iteration deletion must not invent item restoration.

rows.conflict: Carried-forward status/dates and automatic sync are not fresh independently verified evidence.
rows.requirement: Parameterize authoritative field/source, owner, measured time and freshness; distinguish report author from acceptance authority.
rows.negative_test: New report with unchanged inherited values or stale sync must not refresh underlying assessment automatically.

rows.conflict: Classic article redirects to landing do not preserve capability parity or reviewed body identity.
rows.requirement: Verify every declared page-version/redirect/body mapping independently; retain unresolved migration claims.
rows.negative_test: Redirect success cannot certify old article semantics or multiply reviewed source counts.

limitations: Rows and negative tests are proposals, not execution receipts.
Source reference identities do not establish semantic equivalence or independent completeness.
No native changes, rights clearance or acceptance.
